titre: Kasparov played h6. Would you sacrifice the knight? ♟️ #chess #shorts
description:
Deep Blue – Kasparov, game 6, New York, 11 May 1997 (Caro-Kann). After 7…h6 the computer sacrificed a knight on e6: Black's king could never castle, White's pieces flooded in, Bf5 opened the e-file and the rook took the queen. Kasparov resigned after 19 moves and Deep Blue won the match 3.5–2.5. Some think Kasparov mixed up his move order; the sacrifice was already known in theory. Would you have taken on e6? 👇
